title: Digital Passports
subtitle: From the passport counter to Absher and the airport e-gate.
intro: The General Directorate of Passports (Jawazat) handles travel, residency, and border procedures. Most of its services now run on Absher, and at the major airports travellers can pass through automated e-gates. Some of the projects below are already operating and some are announced, so each one is marked with its status.

items.title: Services on Absher
items.text: More than 100 Jawazat services are offered digitally through Absher, including the digital passport.

items.title: Airport E-Gates
items.text: 152 automated e-gates at the airports of Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, and Madinah, built by SDAIA with Jawazat and Matarat and linked to border control, biometrics, airlines, and visa systems.

items.title: Smart Voice Agent
items.text: An automated voice agent answers callers on 992 around the clock.

items.title: Digital Twins
items.text: Digital twin technology, a live virtual model of a real site, was tested during the 2024 Hajj season.

items.title: Smart Track
items.text: Smart cameras that can verify the identity of up to 35 travellers at once, without stopping at a counter.

items.title: Self-Deportation Platform
items.text: An announced digital platform for completing self-deportation procedures online.
